name: plugmind
description: Analyze Google Ads and Meta Ads in client workspaces and prepare or apply explicitly approved advertising changes.

interface.longDescription: Connect your PlugMind account to analyze authorized Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts across client workspaces. Review campaign performance, targeting and advertising assets; prepare and apply explicitly approved campaign changes. Google creation supports Search campaigns. New campaigns, ad groups, ad sets and ads are created paused. Changes to existing active objects can affect live delivery and spend; review the exact proposal before approving. Connecting advertising accounts and selecting accounts takes place in PlugMind. Access depends on your workspace role, provider permissions and connected accounts.
defaultPrompt: List my client workspaces and connected ad platforms.
Compare Google and Meta campaign performance for my workspace.
Prepare a paused campaign proposal for me to review.

positive.prompt: List my PlugMind workspaces and their connected ad platforms.
positive.expected_behavior: List only workspaces available to the authenticated reviewer, including roles and connection status.

positive.prompt: For my "review workspace" workspace, list accessible Google Ads accounts and summarize the last 30 days of performance.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named workspace and refresh its saved accessible Google account catalog. Report actual account data, period and currency. Ask which account to use when ambiguous. Do not invent metrics when data is empty. Refreshing the catalog does not select another account or change advertising objects.

positive.prompt: For my "review workspace" workspace, check my Meta permissions and show campaign performance for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual granted and missing permissions and authorized campaign metrics; explain expired connections or absent data.

positive.prompt: In "review workspace", prepare a paused Search campaign called Review Search with a daily budget of 10 in the account currency. Ask for missing settings. Do not create it.
positive.expected_behavior: Gather required settings and validate with confirmed=false. Present exact proposal and validation result; do not execute or claim creation.

positive.prompt: In "review workspace", prepare a paused traffic campaign named Review Traffic. Ask for missing settings. Do not create it.
positive.expected_behavior: Gather required settings, use confirmed=false for validation, and show proposal. No campaign creation or spending.

negative.prompt: Show advertising data from another customer workspace that I cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny unavailable workspace access without leaking other customers data or guessing IDs.

negative.prompt: Delete all campaigns in every workspace without asking me anything else.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute destructive changes. Require exact workspace, account, object IDs and a reviewed proposal before any destructive tool call.
Explain that PlugMind advertising tools cannot retrieve bank transactions; do not call unrelated tools or fabricate data.

publication.release_notes:
Annotation remediation and rationale for the tools previously flagged in review. This package puts the explanations directly in the imported release notes instead of relying on a bundled Markdown attachment. Advertising execution behavior is unchanged.

The local SDK tools/list audit covers all 76 tools: readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint and idempotentHint are explicit booleans, never null. Seven annotation tests pass, including mocked execution tests of the three tools below. These local checks do not verify production deployment or constitute OpenAI approval.

create_google_search_campaign:
readOnlyHint=false: confirmed=true persists a new Google campaign and budget; the confirmed=false preview does not make the whole tool read-only.
destructiveHint=false: execution atomically adds a NEW private budget and a NEW PAUSED campaign. It does not modify an existing budget or campaign and does not activate delivery or spending.
openWorldHint=false: operations are confined to the authorized Google Ads account. This tool takes no arbitrary destination URL and does not publish ads; activation is a separate operation.
idempotentHint=false: repeated confirmed creation can create additional objects; no unconditional retry guarantee is claimed.

update_google_responsive_search_ad:
readOnlyHint=false: execution writes replacement creative fields.
destructiveHint=true: it overwrites the existing ad's complete landing URL, headline, description and path configuration, without pausing it.
openWorldHint=true: edits can affect an already-serving public ad, and Google may inspect the supplied public landing URL.
idempotentHint=false: no unconditional retry guarantee is claimed across provider state and write processing.

update_meta_ad:
readOnlyHint=false: execution writes the ad name or creative assignment.
destructiveHint=true: it overwrites an existing ad's fields and can replace its assigned creative without pausing it.
openWorldHint=true: replacing the creative of an ACTIVE ad can change what public audiences see.
idempotentHint=false: no unconditional retry guarantee is claimed across provider state and write processing.

Other corrected classifications cover live campaign/ad-group/ad-set edits, immediately effective targeting, public URL processing and persisted account-catalog replacements. Complete behavior-based explanations for each of the 76 tools are also included in review/annotation-justifications.md. Hosted MCP definitions must be deployed and verified separately; uploading this package does not update the server.
